title: UC1 loan 1 whole repayment schedule: the three observed principal components sum to the disbursed principal and amortize to zero (Tier-D MNT replay)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the WHOLE repayment schedule of UC1 loan 1 from the Tier-D MNT replay of LoanRepaymentSchedule.feature (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits; product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DECL_BAL_SARP_EMI_360_30_INT_RECALC_DAILY_MULTIDISB_PARTIAL_PERIOD). request.schedule_amortization transcribes repaymentSchedule.totalPrincipalDisbursed 1000.00 -> "100000" minor units and the three observed repayment-period principalDue values 330.02,333.32,336.66 -> 33002,33332,33666. The disbursement row(s) carry no principalDue and are NOT components, exactly as period 0 is excluded on the single-disbursement captures. expect.principal_sum_minor and expect.final_principal_balance_minor are TRANSCRIPTIONS, not recomputations: the components sum to 100000 = the disbursed principal, and the final period's principalLoanBalanceOutstanding is 0.0, so the final balance is "0". At this point in the replay loan 1 has had a single disbursement of 1000.00 (1000.00 on 2025-01-01); the scenario gives it a second 200.00 tranche later, but the schedule this vector transcribes is the 1000.00 state. Nothing was computed by this promotion.
